verdict.rationale: Teller is a banking-data API platform, not a coding agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server or an agent-connection endpoint. The docs cover only REST APIs, webhooks, Teller Connect and the sandbox, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
